body.name: Certificate-preserving margin-kernel compression handle
body.construction: Given a finite law \(Q\in\mathcal Q(o,e)\) attaining either \(L(o,e)\) or \(U(o,e)\), form the zero-one margin matrix whose \(mr\) observational rows are indexed by \(\mathcal X\times\mathcal Y\), whose \(m(r-1)\) intervention rows omit label \(r\) for each treatment coordinate, and whose columns are indexed by the positive response atoms of \(Q\). While the active columns are linearly dependent, choose an exact nonzero kernel vector, move maximally in either nonnegative direction, delete newly zero atoms, and retain the original active-affine or minimum-cut certificate. Apply this compression separately to the lower- and upper-endpoint laws. For the matching support lower direction, retain the forced-positive-cell family used to lower-bound \(\max\{s_L(o,e),s_U(o,e)\}\).
